claim: Try it with sample data opens an isolated three-record queue, and Reset demo restores it.
where: landing first screen, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; open the landing page; click the sample action; edit and reset demo data; seed a separate real workspace and confirm it is unchanged

claim: The demo and saved queue reopen offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context at /demo; wait for service-worker control; edit and offline-reload the demo; start a real workspace, import and edit a queue, then offline-reload it

claim: During the free metadata workflow, photos and metadata stay on this device.
where: landing facts, privacy page, footer, README
sandbox: fresh Chromium context at /demo; record every request while editing and exporting; assert every request is same-origin and data uses the demo IndexedDB

claim: Caption Queue exports well-formed XMP with XML-sensitive text escaped.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context at /demo; add ampersand and angle brackets; export the sample sidecar; parse it as XML and inspect escaped source

claim: Selected photos become local queue records even when their previews cannot be decoded.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context entered through /demo; start for real; select two JPEG fixtures with undecodable preview bytes; assert both queue records

claim: Caption tokens, controlled terms, and required-field validation update sample metadata.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context at /demo; insert a filename token; add a controlled term; exercise validation failure and recovery on the unfinished sample

claim: Write the set exports one XMP sidecar for every queue record when direct folder writing is unavailable.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context at /demo without File System Access; write the sample set; assert three separate named XMP downloads

claim: The free edition accepts 25 records per shoot and stops a 26-record import.
where: landing facts, pricing, license dialog, README
sandbox: fresh Chromium context entered through /demo; start a real empty workspace; import generated 26-row and 25-row CSV fixtures

claim: Field edition costs $24 once, removes the 25-record import limit, adds saved shoots, and enables batch edit patterns.
where: landing facts, pricing, license dialog, terms, README
sandbox: fresh Chromium context entered through /demo; assert price; start for real; use a recorded valid verification response; import a 26-row CSV; apply a title pattern and assert its rendered value; add a second saved shoot

claim: Metadata edits are saved in the browser and survive a reload.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context at /demo; edit a sample title; wait for its demo IndexedDB record; reload and assert the edit

claim: Metadata CSV export includes one row per queue record.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context at /demo; export metadata CSV; assert its header and three sample rows

claim: A workspace backup restores the exported queue records.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context at /demo; export the sample JSON; change a record; import the backup and assert restoration

claim: A JSON workspace backup restores the queue in a separate browser workspace.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context at /demo; change and export the sample JSON; import it into a separate new browser context and assert the restored records

claim: When the File System Access API is available, Write the set writes one XMP sidecar for every queue record.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context at /demo; provide a compatible recorded directory handle; write the sample set; assert all three XMP filenames and content

claim: Previous/Next controls and Cmd/Ctrl+Enter move and save queue records.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context at /demo; use J, Previous, and Next; complete the unfinished sample; press Ctrl+Enter; assert it is saved and ready

claim: Paid-license verification sends only the pasted token to the Sociobot licensing endpoint.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context at /; record the mocked verification request for a pasted fixture token; assert GET, exact endpoint, only the license query key, and no request body

claim: Queue movement and landing import controls work from the keyboard.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context at /demo; move with J and K; start for real; Tab to a visible import control and activate it with Enter
